findings.title: Repeated enqueue silently discards a later deletion deadline
findings.scenario: Enqueue a private object for immediate cleanup, then enqueue the same bucket/key with notBefore set to upload-ticket expiry plus one minute. The unique constraint preserves the earlier deadline.
findings.expected: A repeated enqueue must preserve the latest required safety deadline.
findings.actual: ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING leaves next_attempt_at unchanged. Once the object is unreferenced, runDue can delete it before the later notBefore.
findings.evidence: The four-argument enqueue computes due but its INSERT ignores conflicting rows. V30__media_cleanup.sql defines UNIQUE(bucket, object_key). A two-insert SQL model reproduced retention of the earlier deadline. Existing tests repeat only identical immediate requests.
findings.suggested_fix: For pending conflicts, atomically retain the greater existing/requested deadline. Explicitly define terminal-row re-enqueue behavior.
findings.repro_test: Against PostgreSQL, enqueue a synthetic key immediately, enqueue it again with a future deadline, assert one row with the future deadline, and assert runDue leaves the object untouched before that deadline.

findings.title: Generated directory is secured only after secrets are written
findings.scenario: Run render for a new GENERATED_DIR under a traversable parent with the common umask 022, or rerender a directory left at mode 755 by the previous script.
findings.expected: The generated directory must be owner-only before any secret-bearing file is opened.
findings.actual: mkdir creates traversable directories and sed writes secret-bearing files before chmod 700 runs. Another local user can read them during rendering; a failure before chmod leaves the directory exposed.
findings.evidence: Directory creation occurs at line 61, secret rendering at lines 62–65, and the first owner-only chmod at line 68. render does not set a restrictive umask before these operations.
findings.suggested_fix: Create and chmod GENERATED_DIR to 700 before creating children or opening output files, and use a restrictive umask during rendering.
findings.repro_test: With synthetic values and umask 022, pause rendering before the first output completes and assert GENERATED_DIR is already mode 700. Repeat with a pre-existing mode-755 directory and a forced rendering failure.
